nonclaim: This record checks one exact externally frozen Ferric, tuned vLLM, and tuned SGLang comparison roster and recomputes integer window throughput, exact medians, the fastest-baseline selection, and a deterministic paired-percentile-bootstrap 95% confidence interval from externally collected counters. It enforces a 0.95 lower confidence bound but does not validate the external plan, versions, sources, tuning choices, budget, SLO, collector arithmetic, observation truth, server freshness, hardware behavior, numerical correctness, or independent reproduction; it is not qualification evidence and does not close m1.r33 or M1.

schema.arithmetic: Each engine window rate is floor(total_tokens*1000000000/duration_ns). Even medians are exact reduced rationals. The fastest baseline is the larger median rate, with vLLM winning a tie. The comparison ratio is floor(Ferric_median/baseline_median*1000000). Ten thousand paired resamples of the thirty aligned recorded windows use SplitMix64 seeded by the SHA-256 identity of a domain-separated policy and observation digest pair. The nearest-rank 250th and 9750th sorted estimates form the deterministic percentile-bootstrap 95% interval, and its lower bound must be at least 950000 PPM.
schema.bindings: The policy freezes exact plan, executable, environment, Ferric and fe2o3 source closures, model, tokenizer, weights, schedule, workload, trace, output-limit, implementation, protocol, source, config, tuning, and equal tuning-budget SHA-256 identities before observation.
schema.order: Exactly three starts appear in ascending order. Each contains ten ordered warmup windows followed by ten ordered recorded windows. Every window carries the exact cyclic Ferric/vLLM/SGLang execution order and all three raw counter sets.
schema.output: The checker rereads an exclusive held sibling staging file, publishes with renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE, synchronizes the parent, and finally rebinds and rereads the published pathname. The record carries the exact policy bindings, raw rows, input SHA-256 identities, recomputed engine medians, fastest baseline, Ferric ratio, bootstrap seed identity, and paired-bootstrap interval. Submitted summaries are outside the input schema.
